g.data-description: the 18 SFP cages, SFP 1-18 (CSFP FE/GE, SFP FE/GE/2.5G or SFP+ 10G). Cage n presents ports 2n-1 and 2n with a CSFP and port 2n-1 alone with an SFP/SFP+; the two CSFP interfaces are not declared per cage because a component part cannot carry `interfaces:`. Port groups G1-G5 (G5 = cages 17-18) each take either SFP+ or any mix of CSFP and SFP.
